problems.note: The picture has 2 pizzas cut into 3 slices each (6 slices total) with 5 shaded. Read as 'how much of the pizzas is shaded,' 5 of 6 slices is 5/6, which is true and is offered as distractor choice c. That makes two choices correct. Fix by asking how many one thirds are shaded (or how many 1/3 pieces), or by removing 5/6 from the choices.
'Leo has 9/4 of a bar' is inaccurate: 9/4 is more than two bars, not a part of one bar. Clearer: 'Leo has 9 one fourths, shown in the picture.'
